description: Unofficial Patched of StelNet, due to community request I've brushed this up and solved issues with CPU cycles and remote contact call incompatibility with mods like UAF on StelNets end. Market refresh is throttled to every 0.25 seconds and walks a cached market list. Fixed UI issues and bugs, tag filters, and LunaLib settings. I fixed that and more issues the forum had with the mod.
